# log index

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:logIndex`](gmeow-logIndex.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/logIndex>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/attestation`](../../slices/attestation.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The index of a ledger event within its containing block or transaction.

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:LedgerEvent`](../classes/gmeow-LedgerEvent.md) -> [`xsd:integer`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#integer); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:logIndex`](gmeow-logIndex.md) from [`gmeow:LedgerEvent`](../classes/gmeow-LedgerEvent.md) to [`xsd:integer`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#integer) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:LedgerEvent`](../classes/gmeow-LedgerEvent.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to carry the position of a [`gmeow:LedgerEvent`](../classes/gmeow-LedgerEvent.md) within its containing block or transaction — the offset that disambiguates one emitted log from another in the same record.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for a transparency-log entry's position in its log (that is [`gmeow:logEntryIndex`](gmeow-logEntryIndex.md)) or a block's chain height ([`gmeow:blockNumber`](gmeow-blockNumber.md)); this is the in-block event offset. Functional — one index per event.

### How to use

- Set one integer offset on the [`gmeow:LedgerEvent`](../classes/gmeow-LedgerEvent.md); combine it with the containing transaction hash and block to address the event uniquely on the chain.

### Examples

- ex:transferEvent [`gmeow:logIndex`](gmeow-logIndex.md) 3.
